Where each fixture came from. Regenerate from the gateway's own tests once
its External and Loop endpoints land; any difference is a bug on one side.

public-node-external.json
public-node-loop.json
    autognomus 786bd8455783af3eaa1abba2357b5900d6afde1f,
    docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-external-tasks-loops-and-run-visibility-design.md
    section 8.4, rewritten to the resolved shape: internally tagged by
    `kind` as `PublicNode` is, and `retry.attempts` as `RetrySpec` is.

feature-from-ticket.workflow.json
    Written by hand from the dev workflows design (4.3, 4.4) as the body
    vetinari must register for one feature-from-ticket run. `triggers`
    follows autognomus-gateway/src/http/workflows.rs at the same commit.

claim-preflight-first.json
claim-implement-rework.json
claim-open-pr.json
    autognomus 786bd8455783af3eaa1abba2357b5900d6afde1f, engine spec
    section 5.3 (the `Task` a claim replies with) and 5.4 (the loop
    envelope and loop output), with `TaskId` in the resolved
    `<run>~<instance>~<attempt>` form. `config` is the matching node's
    config from feature-from-ticket.workflow.json.

run-graph.json
instance-statuses.json
    autognomus 0c95213, engine spec section 6 (`RunGraphView`,
    `GraphNode`, `InstanceView`, `InstanceStatus`) and the amended
    `RunStateView` (`Pending | Active { in_flight } | Completed | Failed
    | Cancelled`). The spec gives the types, not their serde shape; the
    shape here follows the engine's own views (`RunView`, `TaskView`):
    a status flattened beside its fields and tagged by `state`, a node
    kind flattened and tagged by `kind`, lowercase, timestamps RFC 3339.
    Confirm against the gateway when the graph endpoint lands.

run-view.json
workflow-runs.json
    autognomus 0c95213, autognomus-workflow-api/src/view.rs (`RunView`,
    outputs keyed by instance) with the amended state, and
    autognomus-gateway/src/http/runs.rs (`GET /v1/runs/{id}`,
    `GET /v1/workflows/{id}/runs` returning `[RunView]`).

workflows.json
    autognomus 0c95213, autognomus-gateway/src/http/workflows.rs
    (`GET /v1/workflows` returning `[WorkflowView]`). Only `id` is read.

run-events.sse
    autognomus 0c95213, engine spec sections 7.1 (node transitions and
    their extra fields; every node event carries run, workflow, instance,
    attempt, at and seq; `loop.iteration` carries run, instance,
    iteration and seq), 7.3 (`seq`) and 8.2 (`event: <transition>` with
    the event's JSON as data, and `event: resync`). The spec does not name
    the SSE events beyond `<transition>`; the names here are the bus
    subjects without `ag.run.` (`node.ready`, `loop.iteration`,
    `completed`), which also tells run events from node events. Run
    events follow autognomus-gateway/src/outbound/runs.rs (`run`,
    `workflow`) with `seq` added. Confirm when gateway task 9 serves the
    stream.
